1909:             })
1910:         }

1917:                 command.checkpoint_label_len,
1918:             )?;

1920:                 checkpoint_id,
1921:                 label,
1922:             })
1923:         }

1926:                 &command.checkpoint_id,
1927:                 command.checkpoint_id_len,
1928:             )?);

1930:                 decode_optional_identifier(&command.new_branch_id, command.new_branch_id_len)?

1934:                 new_branch_id,
1935:             })
1936:         }

1950: 
1951: fn decode_source_mass(value: f64, body_class: &BodyClass, mass_kg: f64) -> Result<f64, SlResult> {
1952:     if value.is_nan() || value < 0.0 {
1953:         return Ok(BodyState::default_source_mass_kg(body_class, mass_kg));
1954:     }
1955:     if !value.is_finite() {
1956:         return Err(status(SlStatusCode::InvalidArgument));
1957:     }
1958:     Ok(value)
1959: }
1960: 
1961: fn decode_body_class(value: SlBodyClass) -> Result<BodyClass, SlResult> {
1962:     match value {
1963:         SlBodyClass::Star => Ok(BodyClass::Star),
1964:         SlBodyClass::Planet => Ok(BodyClass::Planet),
1965:         SlBodyClass::DwarfPlanet => Ok(BodyClass::DwarfPlanet),
1966:         SlBodyClass::Moon => Ok(BodyClass::Moon),
1967:         SlBodyClass::SmallBody => Ok(BodyClass::SmallBody),
1968:         SlBodyClass::Tracer => Ok(BodyClass::Tracer),
1969:         SlBodyClass::Spacecraft => Ok(BodyClass::Spacecraft),
1970:         SlBodyClass::Custom => Ok(BodyClass::Custom),
1971:         SlBodyClass::Comet => Ok(BodyClass::Comet),
1972:     }
1973: }
1974: 
1975: fn decode_vector3d(value: SlVector3d) -> Vector3d {
1976:     Vector3d {
1977:         x: value.x,
1978:         y: value.y,
1979:         z: value.z,
1980:     }
1981: }
1982: 
1983: fn runtime_error_to_status(error: RuntimeError) -> SlResult {
1984:     match error {
1985:         RuntimeError::DuplicateBody(_)
1986:         | RuntimeError::UnknownBody(_)
1987:         | RuntimeError::UnknownScenario(_)
1988:         | RuntimeError::InvalidEpochDelta(_)
1989:         | RuntimeError::InvalidPlaybackRate(_)
1990:         | RuntimeError::UnknownCheckpoint(_)
1991:         | RuntimeError::DuplicateCheckpoint(_)
1992:         | RuntimeError::DuplicateBranch(_)
1993:         | RuntimeError::PackagePlanFailed(_)
1994:         | RuntimeError::NoInstalledManifestAvailable
1995:         | RuntimeError::PackageNotInstalled(_)
1996:         | RuntimeError::MountedPackageMissingFromStore(_) => status(SlStatusCode::InvalidArgument),
1997:         RuntimeError::PackageApplyFailed(_) => status(SlStatusCode::InternalError),
1998:         RuntimeError::AdvanceBusy => status(SlStatusCode::Busy),
1999:         RuntimeError::AdvanceStale => status(SlStatusCode::Stale),
2000:         RuntimeError::AdvanceWorkLimit => status(SlStatusCode::WorkLimit),
2001:     }
2002: }
2003: 
2004: fn solver_for_cpu_backend(cpu_backend: &CpuBackend) -> SolverBackend {
2005:     match cpu_backend {
2006:         CpuBackend::ReferenceScalar => SolverBackend::ReferenceScalar,
2007:         CpuBackend::SimdArm64 => SolverBackend::SimdArm64,
2008:         CpuBackend::SimdX64 => SolverBackend::SimdX64,
2009:     }
2010: }
2011: 
2012: fn cpu_backend_for_solver_backend(solver_backend: &SolverBackend) -> CpuBackend {
2013:     match solver_backend {
2014:         SolverBackend::ReferenceScalar => CpuBackend::ReferenceScalar,
2015:         SolverBackend::SimdArm64 => CpuBackend::SimdArm64,
2016:         SolverBackend::SimdX64 => CpuBackend::SimdX64,
2017:     }
2018: }
2019:
